en.headline: Mainland universities admitting DSE students rise to 169
en.dek: The Education Bureau welcomed the increase for the 2027-28 academic year, with applications opening from December 1.
body: The Education Bureau said on Monday that the number of mainland higher education institutions participating in the scheme to admit Hong Kong DSE students will rise to 169 for the 2027-28 academic year.
The institutions are spread across 21 provinces or municipalities and two autonomous regions. Students can apply based on their DSE results without sitting the mainland joint entrance exam.

A bureau spokesman said the participating universities offer a variety of programmes and encouraged Hong Kong students to study on the mainland to learn more about the latest social, economic and cultural developments.

Applications open from 1 to 31 December 2026. The Principal's Nomination Programme allows each secondary school to nominate up to eight students, with minimum requirements including an 'Attained' in Citizenship and Social Development and a total of at least eight points in the three core subjects.

zh.headline: 內地高校招收DSE生增至169所 下月開始報名
zh.dek: 教育局歡迎數目增加至2027/28學年，學生可於12月1日起報名。
body: 教育局周一表示，參與招收香港中學文憑考試學生計劃的內地高等院校數目，將2027/28學年增至169所。
院校分佈內地21個省或直轄市及兩個自治區。學生可依據DSE成績報名，毋須參加內地聯招考試。
教育局發言人指，參與計劃的高校提供各有特色的課程，鼓勵香港學生到內地升學，把握機會認識國家最新社會、經濟和文化面貌。
報名期為2026年12月1日至31日。校長推薦計劃下每間中學可推薦最多八名學生，最低要求包括公民與社會發展科「達標」，以及三科核心科目總分至少八分。
